<!-- Generated by Kora's design director. This is the design decision the site was built
     from. Business: 32th Oral Care. -->

# DESIGN.md — 32th Oral Care

stylesheet: assets/site.css
archetype: clinical-warm
rationale: >
  A family dental practice led by a named dentist in Brewster, NY needs calm authority plus
  approachability — clinical blues (#034b76), full-bleed photography, and Sora/Manrope
  typography deliver that without a colder corporate register or sparse architectural-minimal look.
interaction_level: L2

personality: [gentle, honest, clinical, reassuring, modern]

typography:
  display: "Sora"
  body: "Manrope"
  scale: 1.25
  notes: >
    Display (Sora) for nav, headlines, CTAs, and card titles — 600–800 weight.
    Body (Manrope) for paragraphs and form fields. Hero h1 uses clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 3.85rem)
    / 800, tracked −0.02em. Section titles clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.7rem) / 800.
    Eyebrows in Sora 700, ~12–13px, letter-spacing 0.12–0.14em, uppercase, brand-light (#0a6ba6)
    or muted white on dark hero. Body ~1.05–1.06rem / 1.55–1.7 line-height in --text / --text-mid.
    Pill CTAs use Sora 700. No serifs.

palette:
  primary: "#034b76"
  primary_dark: "#022f4b"
  accent: "#0a6ba6"
  tint: "#eef4f8"
  tint_alt: "#f6f9fb"
  ink: "#0e2230"
  text: "#16242e"
  text_mid: "#4a5a64"
  secondary_surface: "#eef4f8"
  application: >
    Brand #034b76 is the primary CTA fill, section accents, links, and scrolled-header CTA.
    Brand-dark #022f4b is the footer ground and deeper hover. Brand-light #0a6ba6 for eyebrows
    and lighter accents. Tint bands (#eef4f8 / #f6f9fb) for alternating sections (services,
    FAQ, soft cards). Hero uses a full-bleed photo with dark navy scrim gradients for white
    type. White (#ffffff) for type on dark surfaces, hero primary CTA fill, and card interiors.
    Gold (#f4a91b) only for star ratings. Status green (#22c55e / #e7f7ee) for open-hours badges
    where present.

composition:
  whitespace: generous
  photography: hero
  card_usage: selective
  mobile: >
    Fixed header: logo left (white-filtered over hero; natural when scrolled), burger right.
    Mobile panel slides from the right with logo, section links, and call CTA.
    Hero locked to 100svh; content bottom-aligned; typography and button padding tighten on
    small viewports / short heights so CTAs stay above the fold. Services grid stacks;
    about becomes single column; contact form stacks over info/map. Footer columns stack.

shell:
  header: >
    Fixed over the hero, transparent until scroll (>24px), then frosted white
    (rgba(255,255,255,.92)) with soft brand shadow. Logo image
    (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/de8c94d8-887e-4625-825f-ec262dbc28df/1789559559_u29vml.png)
    at 48px (40px when scrolled); inverted to white over the hero, natural colors when scrolled.
    Desktop nav: About, Services, Reviews, FAQ, Contact — Sora 600 15px; plus outlined phone
    pill and solid "Book Appointment" CTA. Scrolled state flips nav to ink/brand colors and
    brand-filled CTA.
  nav: ["About", "Services", "Reviews", "FAQ", "Contact"]
  footer: >
    Background #022f4b. Four groups on desktop (brand + rating; Explore; Services; Get in touch),
    stacked on mobile. Brand block uses logo + "32th Oral Care" + short practice line + Google
    rating. Explore and Services are in-page anchor links. Get in touch shows address, phone,
    fax. Bottom bar: © year and serving line.

pages:
  - slug: index
    title: "32th Oral Care – Gentle Family Dentistry in Brewster, New York"
    description: "32th Oral Care offers gentle, modern family and cosmetic dentistry in Brewster, New York. General, restorative, implants, emergency care and more for every age."
    intent: "Primary conversion page — book a visit"
    takes: [hero, about, services, reviews, faq, contact]

sections:
  - id: hero
    layout: full-bleed-overlay
    show: index
    spec: >
      Full viewport height (100vh / 100svh, max-height locked so content cannot grow past the
      fold). Background image
      (https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/v2-uploads/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/c9df57a8-27b8-43ba-931c-c99f0c99c4f9-hero-patient.webp)
      object-fit cover, object-position center. Dual scrim gradients for legibility.
      Bottom-left content: kicker "Brewster, NY · Family dentistry"; h1 "Gentle, honest care
      for your whole family."; one supporting sentence naming Dr. Balu M. Krishna; CTAs
      "Book an Appointment" (white fill / brand text) and "Explore Services" (ghost outline).
      Minimal first viewport — no stats strip, no cards on the hero. Fade-up reveal on load.

  - id: about
    layout: split-visual
    show: index
    spec: >
      White ground, section padding clamp(64px, 8vw, 108px). Left: doctor portrait
      (doctor.webp) with soft brand-tint backdrop and name/credentials card overlay.
      Right: eyebrow "About 32th Oral Care", section title, two leads, four checkmark feature
      chips (gentle visits, honest recommendations, all ages, same-day emergency).

  - id: services
    layout: numbered-card-grid
    show: index
    spec: >
      Tint ground (#f6f9fb / #eef4f8). Header with eyebrow "Our Services", title, lead.
      Six service cards in a responsive grid — number, title, short description; soft card
      shadow and lift on hover. Items: General & Preventive, Cosmetic, Restorative, Implants,
      Emergency, Children & Family.

  - id: reviews
    layout: sidebar-plus-cards
    show: index
    spec: >
      White ground. Left sidebar with rating summary; right: three review quote cards with
      stars, quote, and attribution. Gold stars (#f4a91b).

  - id: faq
    layout: accordion
    show: index
    spec: >
      Soft tint ground. Section header + accordion list (faq-item / faq-toggle). First item
      open by default. Answers reference phone (845) 279-3482 and hours where relevant.
      Visible FAQ content aligns with FAQPage JSON-LD on the page.

  - id: contact
    layout: split-form
    show: index
    spec: >
      White / tint split. Left: booking form (name, phone, email, message) with success state.
      Right: visit details — address 504 N Main St, Brewster, NY 10509; phone; fax; hours list
      with today highlight; map / directions link. Primary CTA "Request Appointment".

assets:
  stylesheet_live: assets/site.css
  stylesheet_alias: assets/styles.css
  tokens_source: src/input.css
  logo: https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/de8c94d8-887e-4625-825f-ec262dbc28df/1789559559_u29vml.png
  favicon: https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/user-media/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/de8c94d8-887e-4625-825f-ec262dbc28df/1789559545_u0r1os.jpg
  hero_image: https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/v2-uploads/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/c9df57a8-27b8-43ba-931c-c99f0c99c4f9-hero-patient.webp
  doctor_image: https://quseprdus1.blob.core.windows.net/kora-business-images/v2-uploads/d9d3e3cf-e6f3-44e0-9876-83a0b241d44f/8cb760e5-2a9e-41ab-8d3a-0e0cb3072134-doctor.webp

avoid:
  - purple-on-white / purple-to-indigo AI default themes
  - warm cream + terracotta editorial cliché
  - broadsheet / dense newspaper columns
  - inset or carded hero images — hero must stay full-bleed
  - stats strips, floating badges, or promo chips overlaid on hero media
  - cards in the hero
  - inventing contact details beyond the known address, phone, and fax
  - dental-site clichés ("state-of-the-art", "cutting-edge", "solutions")
  - loading conflicting legacy stylesheets on index that override site tokens
